tools.name: dnsx
tools.description: DNS resolver + record enumerator (ProjectDiscovery dnsx). Emits Host nodes for resolved A/AAAA records.

tools.name: httpx
tools.description: HTTP probe + fingerprinter (ProjectDiscovery httpx). Emits typed Endpoint/Service/Technology nodes.

paths.description: Paths to probe beneath the target (e.g. ["/", "/api"]).

target.description: URL, host, or IP. httpx accepts the same inputs via stdin; single value here is probed once.

tools.name: kube-bench
tools.description: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark, policies section (RBAC, pod security, network policy, secrets), run through the Kubernetes API. Emits one Finding per control that failed and a BenchmarkRun node that lists every control not assessed. Needs a kubeconfig that the daemon supplies from a tenant secret.

benchmark.description: Optional CIS benchmark version, for example cis-1.12. When absent, the version is chosen from the Kubernetes version the cluster reports.

kubeconfigSecret.description: Name of the tenant secret holding a kubeconfig for the cluster. A name, never a value: a tool's input is stored with the tool call, so the value arrives in the environment instead. The mission must also declare this name in its secrets block for this tool (gibson#485).

target.description: Name of the cluster, as a DNS-style label. It names the result. It is never used to find the cluster: the kubeconfig does that.

tools.name: masscan
tools.description: High-throughput port scanner (masscan). Emits Host/Port nodes for open ports across large CIDR ranges.

tools.name: naabu
tools.description: Fast port scanner (ProjectDiscovery naabu). Emits Host/Port nodes for each open port.

tools.name: nmap
tools.description: TCP/UDP port scanner with service + OS detection. Returns typed Host/Port/Service nodes for the knowledge graph.

ports.description: Port spec — e.g. "22,80,443" or "1-1024". Default: top-1000.

tools.name: nuclei
tools.description: Template-based vulnerability scanner (ProjectDiscovery nuclei). Emits typed Finding nodes with severity + CVSS + MITRE classification when templates supply it.

templates.description: Template IDs or paths (e.g. cves/2023 or a specific template path). Default: nuclei's built-in default template set.

tools.name: subfinder
tools.description: Passive subdomain discovery (ProjectDiscovery subfinder). Emits Domain/Subdomain nodes.

target.description: Root domain to enumerate subdomains for.

tools.name: tlsx
tools.description: TLS configuration and certificate probe (ProjectDiscovery tlsx). Emits a Finding per weak protocol, weak cipher, or certificate problem.

target.description: Host, address or URL to probe.

tools.name: trivy
tools.description: Container image vulnerability scan (Aqua Trivy). Emits Image/Package/Vulnerability nodes and one Finding per affected package.

ignore_unfixed.description: "true" to report only vulnerabilities that have a fixed version.

target.description: Image reference to scan, e.g. ghcr.io/org/app:1.2.3 or app@sha256:<hex>.

tools.name: trivy-k8s
tools.description: Kubernetes workload misconfiguration checks through the Kubernetes API: privileged containers, host namespaces, hostPath mounts, added capabilities, missing security contexts. Emits one Finding per failed check at the severity trivy reports, a Workload node per resource audited, and a ClusterAudit node listing every resource that could not be read. Needs a kubeconfig that the daemon supplies from a tenant secret.

kubeconfigSecret.description: Name of the tenant secret holding a kubeconfig for the cluster. A name, never a value: a tool's input is stored with the tool call, so the value arrives in the environment instead. The mission must also declare this name in its secrets block for this tool (gibson#485).

namespace.description: Optional single namespace to audit. When absent, every namespace the credential can read is audited.

target.description: Name of the cluster, as a DNS-style label. It names the result. It is never used to find the cluster: the kubeconfig does that.
